qr-code.title: Free QR Code Generator | QR for Links, WhatsApp, Wi-Fi and vCards | Mufeed Tools
qr-code.description: Create a QR code for a link, WhatsApp number, Wi-Fi password, vCard or account details. Change the colours, add a logo, download PNG or JPG, or print a poster. Free.
qr-code.lead: Create a QR code for a link, WhatsApp, Wi-Fi, a vCard or account details. Change the colours, add a logo, then download it or print a poster. Everything happens in your browser and your data goes nowhere.
qr-code.libFail: The QR library did not load. Check your internet connection and reopen the page.
qr-code.payWarn: This tab writes the name, bank and account/IBAN as plain text inside the QR. It is not an official payment QR from a bank, and bank apps will not necessarily read it as a payment. For an official merchant QR, contact your bank. Scan the code with your own phone before putting a poster up.
qr-code.hint: Keep the QR dark and the background light so it scans easily, and keep any logo small and simple.
qr-code.lowContrast: The two colours are too similar and the QR may not scan. Pick a dark and a light colour.
qr-code.tooLong: The text is too long for a QR code. Please shorten it.
qr-code.empty: Type the details to see the QR
qr-code.scanPay: Scan the QR to see the details
qr-code.popup: Allow pop-ups to print the poster

qr-code.howTitle: How to make a QR code
how: Choose the type of QR at the top.
Fill in the details; the QR changes as you type.
Change the colours and add a logo if you like.
Download PNG or JPG, or print a poster.
Scan it with your phone camera to check it before using it.

faq.q: Will the QR code keep working forever?
faq.a: Yes. It is a simple QR that contains only what you typed. It has no expiry and is not tied to our site.

faq.q: Does my information or Wi-Fi password go anywhere?
faq.a: No. The QR is made in your browser and we store nothing. But anyone who has the QR image can read what is in it, so share a password QR carefully.

faq.q: Is this an official bank payment QR?
faq.a: No. The “Account details” QR only shows what you typed. For an official payment QR, contact your bank.

faq.q: Why does my QR not scan?
faq.a: Scanning is harder if the colours are too similar, the logo is large or the text is very long. Keep the QR dark and the background light.
